studyMetadata.title: Answer Validation and Feedback Demo
studyMetadata.description: Try correct and incorrect answers with numeric ranges, alternative answers, selection sets, custom feedback, and hints for each attempt.

response.prompt:
# Exact Answers and Lists

Try an incorrect answer first, then correct it and click **Check Answer** again. All three responses must be correct to continue early.

response.secondaryText: Correct: United States, USA, or US. Incorrect: Canada. Text matches are case-insensitive.

response.prompt: Enter a whole number from 1 through 5.

feedback.correctText: Yes! Adding two and two gives four.
feedback.incorrectText: Not quite. Maybe you should go back to school and review your addition skills.
feedback.exhaustedText: You used all {attemptsUsed} attempts. Review the accepted answers, then continue.
hints: Count two, then two more.

feedback.correctText: Yes, that is an accepted name for the United States.
feedback.incorrectText: That is not a name of the United States.
feedback.exhaustedText: You used all {attemptsUsed} attempts. Review the accepted answers, then continue.
hints: Use the full country name or a common abbreviation.
Hint: United States, USA, or US.

feedback.correctText: That number is on the accepted list.
feedback.incorrectText: That number is not on the accepted list.
feedback.exhaustedText: You used all {attemptsUsed} attempts. Review the accepted answers, then continue.
hints: Choose a listed value, rather than a number between two values.
Hint: 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 are accepted.

response.prompt:
# Numeric Ranges

Boundary values count as correct. Try a value outside each range to see incorrect feedback.

response.secondaryText: Correct: -10, 0, 10, or any number between the endpoints. Incorrect: -11 or 11.
Correct: >=0; Incorrect: -1. There is no upper bound.
Correct: <=0; Incorrect: 1. There is no lower bound.

feedback.correctText: Your number is inside the range, including its endpoints.
feedback.incorrectText: Your number is outside the accepted range.
feedback.exhaustedText: You used all {attemptsUsed} attempts. Review the accepted answers, then continue.
hints: Try a number closer to zero.
Hint: -10 through 10 are accepted, including both endpoints.

feedback.correctText: Your number is at least zero.
feedback.incorrectText: Your number is below the lower bound.
feedback.exhaustedText: You used all {attemptsUsed} attempts. Review the accepted answers, then continue.
hints: Try zero or a positive number.
Hint: there is no upper bound; zero is accepted.

feedback.correctText: Your number is at most zero.
feedback.incorrectText: Your number is above the upper bound.
feedback.exhaustedText: You used all {attemptsUsed} attempts. Review the accepted answers, then continue.
hints: Try zero or a negative number.
Hint: there is no lower bound; zero is accepted.

response.prompt:
# Alternative Selection Sets

Select one complete accepted set for each question. Selecting just part of a set or mixing the sets is incorrect.
Select A and B, or C and D.
response.secondaryText: Correct: A + B or C + D, in either selection order. Incorrect: A + C or A + B + C.

response.prompt: What is the square root of 16?
response.secondaryText: Correct answer: 4 and -4 and any alteration of that.

response.prompt: For each animal, select all that apply.
Select two colors from one accepted pair.
response.secondaryText: Correct: Red + Blue or Green + Yellow, in either selection order. Incorrect: Red + Green.

response.prompt: Rank one accepted pair of letters.
response.secondaryText: Correct: A then B, or C then D. Incorrect: B then A, or A then C. Move exactly two letters into the ranked list.

feedback.correctText: You chose one complete accepted letter pair.
feedback.incorrectText: Those selections do not form an accepted pair.
feedback.exhaustedText: You used all {attemptsUsed} attempts. Review the accepted answers, then continue.
hints: Choose both letters from the same pair.
Hint: choose A + B or C + D, without extra letters.

feedback.incorrectText: Not all of the options are correct or you missed some.
feedback.exhaustedText: You used all {attemptsUsed} attempts. Review the accepted answers, then continue.
hints: More than one answer is correct.
Take a better look, you should know this from school.

feedback.correctText: All five rows match the accepted traits.
feedback.incorrectText: Some rows are missing a correct trait or include a trait that does not apply.
feedback.exhaustedText: Review the accepted traits, then continue.
hints: Compare fur, wings, tails, and typical adult height.
Cats, dogs, rats, and horses have fur and tails; adult horses are taller than people. Pigeons have wings and tails.

feedback.correctText: You chose one complete accepted color pair.
feedback.incorrectText: Those colors do not form an accepted pair.
feedback.exhaustedText: You used all {attemptsUsed} attempts. Review the accepted answers, then continue.
hints: Keep the two colors in the same accepted pair.
Hint: choose Red + Blue or Green + Yellow.

feedback.correctText: Your letters are in an accepted order.
feedback.incorrectText: Both the selected letters and their order matter.
feedback.exhaustedText: You used all {attemptsUsed} attempts. Review the accepted answers, then continue.
hints: Try two letters from the same pair in alphabetical order.
Hint: rank A then B, or C then D.

response.prompt:
# Unlimited Attempts

Try 140 and click **Check Answer** repeatedly to see progressively more specific hints. After the second hint, later attempts repeat it. Enter a correct value to continue.

feedback.correctText: You found the range on attempt {attemptsUsed}.
feedback.incorrectText: That is outside the range. You have {attemptsLeft} attempts left.
hints: Look for a number near 155.
Choose a number from 150 to 160, including the endpoints.
Use any number in between 150 and 160.
PLEASE write 155.
PLEASE JUST DO WHAT I SAID, TAKE 155!
I SAID 155. Look at what you entered. Does that look like 155?
This is getting ridiculous.
I give up. Just pick 155.
Alright, at this point I don't care anymore, just keep going.
I don't even know why I am still giving hints.
The answer is 155. Do what you will with that information.
